options: Briefly describe the positive impact of AI in our daily life.
AI has a significant positive impact on daily life in many ways:

questions.stem: Virtual assistants like Siri, Google Assistant, and Alexa help with navigation, information retrieval, and home automation.
options: AI powers recommendation systems, providing personalized shopping experiences.
Overall, AI improves productivity, enhances decision - making, and streamlines various aspects of life.
Identifying and classifying objects in images or videos (e.g., identifying products on an assembly line).
Automating security processes such as user authentication.

questions.stem: Analyzing medical images like X-rays and MRIs to assist in diagnosis.
options: Helping autonomous vehicles interpret road signs, pedestrians, and obstacles.
Computer vision reduces human error, improves efficiency, and enables automation in various industries.
Robots can be deployed to explore deep oceans where humans cannot survive due to pressure and depth.
Robots can assist in taking care of elderly individuals, helping with daily tasks, and providing companionship.

questions.stem: Scalability: Cloud services can be scaled up or down depending on usage, offering flexibility for businesses.
options: Cost Effective: Pay-as-you-go models help save costs as there is no need for heavy upfront investment in hardware.
Remote Access: Cloud computing allows access to data and applications from anywhere with an Internet an connection.
Data Security: Cloud providers offer advanced security measures, including encryption and backups to protect data.

questions.stem: AI Algorithms are not perfect and can produce wrong results due to several factors:
options: If the data used to train the model is biased, the algorithm will produce biased results.
AI might lack understanding of complex, nuanced situations that require human judgement.
Sommetimes the model might perform well on training data but fail to generalize to new, unseen data.
AI models require vast amounts of high-quality data. Incomplete or poor quality data can lead to inaccurate predictions.
